elena (product): Heads-up: rolling out the Private KMS key rotation playback feature to VPC/on‑prem customers this week. This is a preview release; opt-in required.

elena (product): TL;DR: enables safe replay of KMS rotations for customers that manage their own CMKs so they can validate cryptographic compatibility before a live rotation. Preview window: Thu 2026-04-01 -> Fri 2026-04-08.

elena (product): Why: we've seen a few customers hit subtle client-side failures after key rotations (library mismatches, unsupported algorithms). This tool lets you run a rotation in "replay" mode against a staging copy to catch issues.

marta (eng-security): Key points for eng/security: replay never touches live plaintext. It replays rotation metadata and performs crypto ops in an isolated test namespace. Audit logs flagged with `kms.replay` tag.

sam (eng-infra): Is there a CI integration? Can customers trigger replays from their pipeline?

elena (product): Yes — we have a REST endpoint + SDK method. Example: `POST /private/v1/kms/{tenant}/replay?mode=staging` will enqueue a playback. Docs: https://console.internal/redwood/private-kms-replay (preview docs behind auth).

cj (customer-success): Customer impact: we should proactively offer replay sessions to any customer planning a rotation in next 90 days. I'll prepare outreach templates.

amy (privacy): Audit trail question — does replay generate the same set of audit entries as a real rotation? Customers need that for attestations.

marta (eng-security): Short answer: yes, but entries are marked `replay=true` and stored in a separate audit index with 60-day retention by default (preview). We also provide an export bundle for compliance teams.

sam (eng-infra): What about key material? Are we storing any customer private keys?

marta (eng-security): No. Replays operate against wrapped key material provided by customer in their environment. Redwood never unwraps or stores raw key material for the replay.

elena (product): Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha with red-team + 3 pilot customers (Apr 1–2), 2) invite-only preview opens Apr 3, 3) feedback window Apr 3–8, 4) GA decision meeting Apr 15.

elena (product): Action items: - eng-infra: provision preview namespaces + make endpoint stable (sam) - eng-security: finalize audit export and replay tagging (marta) - customer-success: coordinate pilot invites & comms (cj) - privacy/legal: quick review of export bundle (amy)

sam (eng-infra): Will spin up preview namespaces today. Expect a short maintenance blip (sub-second) when we attach replay hooks. I'll post deploy links.

ops-bot: Deployment queued: `replay-preview-v1` to cluster-private-staging. Track at https://ci.internal/builds/98765 — status: queued.

cj (customer-success): I'll prepare two email templates: "Invitation to KMS rotation replay" and "Post-replay checklist". Will share drafts in #customer-success-docs by EOD.

amy (privacy): Please include a blurb about how replay audit logs are segregated and exported. Legal wants to see export format sample.

marta (eng-security): Noted. I'll attach sample export JSON and the schema to the preview docs.

elena (product): Pilot criteria: customers with private-managed KMS + rotation in next 3 months, willing to run in staging. We will not auto-enroll anyone.

sam (eng-infra): Quick tech note for pilots: run `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  https://private-api.redwood/v1/kms/tenants/{t}/replay -d '{"target":"staging"}'`

marta (eng-security): Security checklist for pilots: MFA on admin accounts, SIEM forwarding enabled, rotation of replay service creds after each session.

cj (customer-success): Got it. I'll include checklist and ask pilot customers to confirm SIEM forwarding before we run.

elena (product): Feedback channels: - pilot feedback form (link in docs) - weekly sync Wed 10:00 PT during preview - postmortem doc after each pilot run.

sam (eng-infra): Deployed preview hooks to private-staging. Verified `kms.replay` audit tags appear in the test index.

ops-bot: Deployment succeeded: `replay-preview-v1` -> private-staging. Build 98765 -> success.

marta (eng-security): I'll upload sample export schema to the docs page now.

elena (product): Thanks team. If no major issues during pilot window we'll present GA recommendation on Apr 15. Please ping me directly for blocker escalations. :rocket:
